summary: Add the Merge Queue Removed workflow from Ground Control. It runs on the pull_request enqueued, dequeued, and closed events for dev. It adds the merge-queue-removed label to an open PR that the dev merge queue removed, and removes the label when the PR enters the queue again or closes. docs/CONTRIBUTING.md describes the label. No Go package, import, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The new workflow is not a modeled policy path. It reads the PR state and writes PR labels through the GitHub API with the workflow token, which has only pull-requests write access. It checks out no code and executes no candidate source. Event values reach the shell only through environment variables. The trust_changes entries restate the existing boundaries.
